description: List active static messages and generation prompts for a product, plus the DealSurface built-in default. Each entry includes kind and credit_cost. Listing is free and requires "read" and "outreach" scopes. Normal craft_outreach calls should omit template_key and use the effective default; call this tool when the user asks to explore alternatives.

product_id.description: The product whose outreach templates should be listed
